scope.react: StrictMode, real NativeEditor and Worker modules
scope.input: Playwright trusted pointer/keyboard events; CDP Input.imeSetComposition and Input.insertText for Chinese composition

chromiumCdpEndEventControl.note: This Chromium CDP path emits an untrusted compositionend even for a plain contenteditable control; compositionstart, updates and committed input events are trusted. No JavaScript dispatchEvent was used to generate input.

limits: Flex/grid siblings stay mounted together to preserve browser layout; active edits and selected groups remain mounted.
Thumbnails are bounded visual summaries (96 nodes, 64x40), with cached downsampled images; never-loaded pages show their background until page data has loaded.
This diagnostic is not a substitute for the full product, persistence, export, or performance acceptance runs.
Chinese composition is verified through Chromium CDP, including two pauses longer than the autosave debounce; native OS candidate windows and other browser/OS IMEs are not verified.
